title: Figure One
description: Figure One is a browser-based editor for CONSORT and PRISMA participant flow diagrams. Boxes and their counts are arranged on a node canvas, and the figure is typeset with Typst for export as PDF, SVG or PNG at a chosen resolution. Styling covers the details journals ask about, including fonts, digit grouping, box fills and arrow forms. A flowchart is stored as a plain JSON project file that can be reopened, shared, or kept alongside the manuscript. The Typst compiler runs in the browser as WebAssembly, so no data leaves the machine.
